KD0100-02S-T1 Oxygen Sensor — Probe

O₂ partial pressure 0.5–101 kPa · Cable probe type

Measures oxygen partial pressure from 0.5–101 kPa. Works with an external interface board / KD0100-03 controller for air, pure oxygen, and N₂/O₂ mixtures.

Advantages

  • O₂ partial pressure range: 0.5–101 kPa
  • Works with external interface board / KD0100-03 controller
  • Measures air, pure O₂, and N₂/O₂ mixed gases
  • Cable-harness probe design for easy system integration
